responsibility: This file implements the output side of GCC’s generic typed streaming layer. It manages lto_output_stream block allocation and growth, interns strings into the output_block string table with deduplication hashes, writes indexed strings to ordinary streams or bitpacks, and serializes primitive scalar values such as variable-length HOST_WIDE_INTs, poly_int coefficients, gcov counts, raw byte payloads, and physical wide_int/widest_int representations. Its responsibility is low-level serialization and string-table construction for LTO-style streams, rather than higher-level IR object selection.
